name: link
title: Link
description: An underlined link. External links open safely and say so.
a11y: A real anchor with a visible underline; focus ring shared with other controls.
External links get rel="noopener noreferrer" and a hidden "(opens in a new tab)".

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and announces that.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the child (a router link) instead of an anchor.

usage:
import {Link} from '@monoline/react';

Read the button docs or visit GitHub.
